fullPassage: Brands that fail to grow and develop lose their relevance. Think about the person you knew who was once on the fast track at your company, who is either no longer with the firm, or worse yet, appears to have hit a plateau in his or her career. Assuming he or she did not make an ambitious move, more often than not, this individual is a victim of having failed to stay relevant and embrace the advances in his or her industry. Think about the impact personal computing technology had on the first wave of executive leadership exposed to the technology. Those who embraced the technology were able to integrate it into their work styles and excel. Those who were resistant many times found few opportunities to advance their careers and in many cases were ultimately let go through early retirement for failure to stay relevant and update their skills.

Those who embraced the technology were able to integrate it into their work styles and excel. Those who were resistant many times found few opportunities to advance their careers and in many cases were ultimately let go through early retirement for failure to stay relevant and update their skills.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?
ch: 기술이 발전할수록 경영 지도자의 역할이 줄어든다.
변화를 받아들이지 못하면 업계에서의 적합성을 잃게 된다.
야심에 찬 행동만이 경력 발전의 유일한 방법이다.
조기 은퇴는 개인의 선택이 아니라 회사의 결정이다.

det.korean: ② 변화(발전)를 받아들이지 못하면 적합성을 잃고 결국 도태된다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② 변화 미수용 → 적합성 상실: 글의 요지
❌ ① 경영 지도자 역할 축소: 본문과 다름
❌ ③ 야심만이 유일한 방법: 과도한 해석
❌ ④ 조기 은퇴는 회사 결정: 부분적 사실이나 요지 아님
det.tip: 요지 = 변화 수용 실패 → 적합성 상실 → 도태

questions.passage: Brands that fail to grow and develop lose their relevance. Think about the impact personal computing technology had on the first wave of executive leadership exposed to the technology. Those who were resistant many times found few opportunities to advance their careers and in many cases were ultimately let go through ______ for failure to stay relevant and update their skills.
questions.stem:
다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말을 주어진 조건에 맞게 영어로 쓰시오. (2단어)

[조건] 적합성 유지에 실패하여 겪게 되는 '이른 시기의 퇴직'을 의미하는 표현

det.korean: 이른 시기의 퇴직 = early retirement(조기 은퇴).
det.analysis:
early(이른) + retirement(퇴직/은퇴) = 조기 은퇴
본문: let go through early retirement
